game_concept: A puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Crypt Stairs, stairs to a crypt: the ruin warden must handle ghost knights while practicing lists. Core idea – Reverse Parade: Reverse the order of a parade list with reverse() or slicing.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Crypt Stairs: stairs to a crypt
core_gameplay_loop: In Crypt Stairs, repeat each round: Reverse the order of a parade list with reverse() or slicing. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the parade_ok value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the heart stone using at most 11 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The heart stone reached with actions_used <= 11.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 11 before the heart stone is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 3 (intro tier): Reverse Parade
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Reverse Parade' (Week 7 slot 10), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Crypt Stairs'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how parade_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ghost knights in Crypt Stairs.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The heart stone reached with actions_used <= 11.
